text: Iveco is the truck brand of Iveco Group N.V., incorporated in the Netherlands and listed on Euronext Milan. Its 2025 Annual Report's table of holders of 3% or more as at 31 December 2025 shows Giovanni Agnelli B.V. - held via Exor N.V. - with 42.49% of voting rights, Burlington Loan Management DAC with 5.02%, and Syquant Capital, BlackRock and Citigroup with about 3% each; no state or state fund appears. Iveco and Tata Motors announced on 30 July 2025 a tender offer for Iveco Group, not yet completed when checked in October 2026.
short: Iveco Group is Euronext-listed; Giovanni Agnelli B.V. (via Exor) holds 42.49% of voting rights.
